candidate_reports.remark: The Highway 41 Wildfire is at 100 percent containment with a final total acreage burned of 9_149.
Max Road Fire has grown to 2800 acres and is 0% contained.
Mesonet Lake Okeechobee South End recorded a wind gust of 43 mph at 7:15pm as a strong thunderstorm pushed across Lake Okeechobee.
The 172 Avenue Fire in southeast Miami-Dade is now at 300 acres with 30% containment.
Florida Department of Emergency Management relays report from Florida Forest Service that the Max Road Fire has been put out. Last account of total acreage burned was 11_443.
PBI Airport tower reported a brief waterspout looking east associated with a weak shower.

candidate_reports.remark: Florida Forest Service reports that the Rifle Range Rd wildfire is now at 100% containment with a total burned area of 650 acres.
MM 44 Fire in Broward County has grown to 1200 acres as of this afternoon. The fire is 40% contained and was sparked by a lightning strike on May 23rd.
Florida Forest Service reports the MM-44 fire in Broward County is now at 95% containment and no longer growing in size. The total burned area is 1200 acres.
